==Usage==
To use this template, paste <code><nowiki>{{UserWookieeProject|</nowiki>{{Var|project name}}}}</code> into your user page.

===Required parameters===
#{{Para||{{Var|project name}}}} The title of the project page, with "Wookieepedia:WookieeProject" removed from the beginning. The full URL of the project page may be input as an alternative.
